INTERNAL_ERROR.action: System error occurred. Copy this code and contact support.

PRINT_FAILED.action: Receipt wasn't printed. Check the printer and paper, then tap Reprint.

DEVICE_REVOKED.action: This device has been revoked. Export pending transactions, then contact a manager.

CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED.action: Device credentials expired. Pair the device again.

LEASE_EXPIRED.action: Device locked after 7 days without syncing. Connect to the internet.

UPDATE_REQUIRED.action: App update required. Finish your shift, then reload when prompted.

SYNC_HELD.action: Some transactions are held waiting for an update or the server. No data was lost.

TENANT_SUSPENDED.action: Service for this tenant is currently unavailable. Contact your service provider.

STORAGE_LOW.action: Device storage is almost full. Sync and free up space; pending transactions aren't deleted.

STORAGE_FULL.action: Storage is full, transactions can't be saved. Export pending transactions then free up space.

LOCAL_DB_FAILED.action: Local data couldn't be opened. Export pending transactions then contact support.

APP_ERROR.action: This screen ran into a problem. Tap Retry; your draft is safe.

HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING.action: Bill was already accepted or canceled. Reload the bill list.

EVENTS_PENDING.action: There are still unsent bill changes. Wait for syncing to finish.

RATE_LIMITED.action: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.

FEATURE_DISABLED.action: This feature isn't enabled for your tenant.
